about: people2 skeleton (art-source/tools/blender/build_people2.py, docs/people.md). Game axes: x the person's left, y up, z forward (the person faces +z), metres. Bone frames are the glTF nodes' rest frames: local +y runs along the bone.

boneMap.note: The little finger is weighted to the ring chain (ring1-3), so it curls with the ring finger. eyeL and eyeR are leaves of head that turn the eyeballs (code, never clips).

gripR.note: the right fist's grip: a handle runs along local +y through the closed fist (forward when the arm hangs); local +z points to the wrist, so a blade's edge points along -z (the little finger side). Model a held thing with its grip at the origin and its tip along +y.

gripL.note: the same for the left fist.

hipL.note: the left hip at the belt: a scabbard or sheath hangs from here along local +y (down).

back.note: the middle of the upper back on the skin: a slung load; local +y up the back, local +z out of the back (behind the person).

headTop.note: the crown: a hat sits here; local +y up.

nape.for: the back of the neck: a grab from behind

collarBack.for: the back of the collar: a grab or a drag by the coat

collarFront.for: the lapels: a grab from the front, a shove

mouth.for: a hand over the mouth from behind (a silent attack)

throat.for: a blade or an arm at the throat

chest.for: a blow or a stab to the chest

belly.for: a blow or a stab to the belly

beltBack.for: the belt at the back: a lift or a drag

wristL.for: a grip on the wrist: held, twisted, dragged by the arms

upperArmL.for: a grip on the arm above the elbow: held, led away

armpitL.for: lifting or dragging a body under the arms

ankleL.for: dragging a body by the feet

grips.note: hands closed round a handle across the fist (art-source/tools/blender/people2/preview_b.py fit_grips): curls are MCP, PIP, DIP degrees per finger (the little finger rides on the ring bones), the thumb (across, flex at the base, MCP, IP); axisAt is the handle's axis in the grip socket's own frame (metres): put a handle of that radius there, along the socket's +y

shapeKeys.note: morph targets of <body>_lod0, <kind>_lod0 and the hair pieces (<body>_<hair|beard|mous>_<style>_lod0): MakeHuman's targets as sliders (peopleSliders.json), set once per person at spawn from faceTypes.json's face_for; the far copies carry the body sliders. hands_hard 1 on dockers (kinds.<kind>.shapeKeys).

lod.note: LOD1 also for the mirrors and the lantern shadow

heightFactor.note: per person, from the person's seed (a normal draw, sd 0.02, clamped to min..max): scale the person's top node uniformly by f. Locomotion: every clip's stride, speed and travel times f (the speed blend works on stride*f; the foot lock takes out the rest); sockets, marks, grips and the hips tracks follow the node. (docs/people.md 'Builds')

oldStance.note: bodies with stoopDeg > 0: play <clip>_old where it exists; for any other standing clip add per leg legUp RX(-thighFwdDeg), legLow RX(kneeDeg), foot RX(footDeg) (pose convention, before the clip's own turn) and lower the hips by hipsDrop m (docs/people.md 'The old')

locomotion.about: package D1 clips (art-source/tools/blender/people2/clips_move.py, docs/people.md 'Locomotion'). Loops are two strides, in place: move the node at their speed. Clips that travel move the hips: move the node by their travel at the end. Hips translation tracks are the clip's own body's offset from its rest, added to man_middling's hips rest (trackBase).

blend.weight: neighbours by speed a < v < b: w = (Sa - v Ta) / (v (Tb - Ta) - (Sb - Sa)), S = stride, T = cycle (clip meta); mix rotations by slerp(w) and hips translations by lerp(w)
blend.phase: one shared phase for all loops (each is two strides, left heel at 0 and 0.5), advanced by dt / (2 T), T = lerp(Ta, Tb, w)
blend.ends: below the slowest or above the fastest loop of a family play its end loop at cycle = stride / v
blend.switch: walk to run (and back) as v passes 2.2 m/s: crossfade inside a window where both gaits agree (clips_move.switch_windows: one foot down in both, the other in the air in both), never held as a mix
blend.feet: lock the planted feet with leg IK every frame (motion.lock_feet does it here): blends move the pose, not the feet; measured with the lock: under 2 mm
blend.otherBodies: a clip made on one body plays on another of the same base unchanged; on a smaller or bigger body scale its speed and stride by the ratio of the hips heights (peopleRig bodies.<b>.hipsBone)

sack.note: a sack across the left shoulder, its length along the person's forward, the front end 6 degrees down; centre given from the left shoulder joint (armUpL head) at rest; size: across, length, thickness (the one sack model draped over the shoulder); the left hand's fist holds the bunched front end at `grip` from the centre (clips_work's lift and hold end in the same hold)

crate.note: a crate held in front against the belly, both hands under its sides; centre from the chest bone's head at rest

cart_push.note: the handcart's grips (props.glb handcart: HANDCART_GRIP 0.34 either side, 0.75 m up), the cart ahead; grips run forward along the shafts

cart_pull.note: the same cart turned round: he walks between the shafts and draws it behind him

truck_push.note: a sack truck tipped back toward him (about 45 degrees), wheels ahead, the two handle tips

truck_pull.note: the sack truck drawn behind him, tipped forward onto its wheels

idles.about: package D2 clips (art-source/tools/blender/people2/clips_idle.py, docs/people.md 'Idles, talk and sitting'). Each is made on its family's body and keyed like the D1 clips (hips translation on trackBase). Every loop of a family starts and ends in the family's neutral stance (weight in the middle, feet at their base): hand one over to another at a seam and no foot moves.

rules.variant: pick a family's clip for a motion from the person's stable id (FNV-1a), the same on every PC; let a standing idle change now and then (20-50 s) to another of the family's idles, only at the end of a loop, with a 1 s crossfade
rules.talk: a talker alternates speaking (the talk set) and listening at the end of each loop; a partner within 3 m who also talks takes the other turn; the set comes from the mood if known (angry, cold: cross; warm, amused: eager; else calm), else from the id
rules.sit: the seat's height picks the variant: under 0.32 m a step, under 0.43 a crate, else a bench or a chair by the id; the hips are lowered by the clip; move the node by seat - seat(clip) * scale and put the feet back on the floor with leg IK near the camera
rules.fallback: a family without a clip for a motion uses its fallback family's

work.about: package D3 clips (art-source/tools/blender/people2/clips_work.py, docs/people.md 'Work'). Keyed like D1 and D2 (hips translation on trackBase). things: what a clip moves, either on a bone (offset and turn in the bone's frame, game axes) or a track in the node's frame (t, x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw[, length, thickness, width]; scale positions by the body's hips over the clip body's). families: the clips that serve a game motion (motions) or a context the game knows (contexts), picked by the person's stable id; fallback: the family whose clips it borrows. kinds: kinds whose load decides their clips. loads: where a carried load rides.

sack.note: the one sack model on the left shoulder; size: length, width, thickness (the game model scaled to length, thickness (up), width)

crate.note: a crate (or a box of fish) held against the belly, its middle at offset; size: across, deep, high

rope.note: a rope from the anchor (game axes, node frame) through the upper fist and the lower one (gripL/gripR) down to the tail on the ground

winch.note: the crank's axle across before him (game axes, node frame); the handle along the axle toward his right, at the crank's end
